gold.observation: TTFB is 2,400 ms — very high. The slowest request is the main document itself, /search?q=algebra, at 2,400 ms, which accounts for nearly all of the 3,000 ms LCP. The payload is light (800,000 bytes, 30 requests) and CLS (0.04) and TBT (140 ms) are good.
gold.potential_cause: The server is slow to return the /search?q=algebra document (2,400 ms time-to-first-byte). The delay is server-side response time, not front-end asset weight, since the page is only 800,000 bytes across 30 requests.
gold.suggested_optimization: Investigate server-side response time for the search route (/search?q=algebra) — for example query or caching cost on that endpoint; the front-end payload is already light and is not the bottleneck.
